brief:
An Israeli real estate company held a "Black Friday" land sale event in Brooklyn, Middle East Eye reported, drawing dueling demonstrations outside the venue. Pro-Israel demonstrators threw firecrackers, smoke bombs, and eggs at pro-Palestine protesters gathered at the location.

The nature of the properties being sold and the company's specific identity were not detailed in available reports of the event.

title: Israeli firm holds Brooklyn land sale as protesters clash outside
